cohort: 816 preterm neonates admitted to neonatal intensive care unit at Ayder Comprehensive Specialized Hospital, northern Ethiopia
finding: Neonatal sepsis was significantly associated with cesarean section, male sex, 4-6 APGAR score at 1-min, and hospitalization for more than 14 days, while determinants of respiratory distress syndrome were compound fetal presentation, < 28 weeks of gestational age, 28-31 6/7 weeks of gestational age, 1-1.49 kg birth weight and 4-6 APGAR score at 1-min, and respiratory distress syndrome and perinatal asphyxia were associated with preterm neonatal mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with lower odds of neonatal sepsis.
